policy_extraction.implementation_notes: Meeting minutes of the 2nd AI Strategy Promotion Inter-Ministerial Conference. Key items: AI bill legislative progress reported; Digital Agency presented draft AI government procurement/utilization guidelines and requested ministries appoint Chief AI Officers (CAIO); FSA published AI Discussion Paper on financial sector use cases; METI introduced GENIAC-PRIZE program for generative AI social implementation. Chair noted Diet deliberations touched on human-centric AI, local government AI use, and deepfake pornography risks. Goal stated as making Japan 'the world's most AI-friendly country for development and utilization'.

risk_framing.rationale_summary: The document is primarily framed around enabling rapid AI adoption and social implementation ('world's most AI-friendly country for development and utilization', promoting generative AI deployment programs, and accelerating nationwide AI implementation), with national economic competitiveness as a closely paired secondary rationale.
